description: Deterministic zero-install structural preflight for public GitHub repositories, with machine-readable output and local coding-tooling handoff.

operations.description: Discover the other public coding-agent tools and their stable agent-tool.json contracts.
Browser-executed schema-v1 remote-preflight JSON for coding agents.
Browser-executed test-coverage observation that prefers standardized CI-published snapshots and falls back to recognized committed reports.
Human-readable per-commit repository progress score history with structural and verification trends.
Versioned coding-tooling/score-history/v1 snapshots retained on the dedicated score-history branch.

limitations: Remote analysis supports public GitHub repositories only and uses anonymous GitHub API data.

GitHub Pages cannot execute repository commands; local coding-tooling or repository CI remains authoritative for coverage generation, validation, conformance, environment verification, findings, scoring, and mutations.
A complete repository progress score requires a fresh local or CI coding-tooling run report; structural-only scoring remains explicitly incomplete.
Score history is a per-commit trend for the versioned scoring profile; scoring-profile expansion can change what 100 means.
The analysis-json and test-coverage views are browser-executed rather than server-side application/json HTTP APIs.
